text: {"lessons":["I will base buy and sell decisions on the stock’s prospects and current evidence, not just whether I am above or below my average cost.","I will avoid frequent reversals: before opening a position, I will set out why I expect it to outperform and what would change my view.","I will manage position sizes and keep enough cash to handle volatility, while judging long-run results against the overall market rather than a few monthly gains or losses."]}
